text: Audit every place Athena calls GitHub (gh CLI or the API) or another external service, and route all of them through a single wrapper with bounded retry. The wrapper retries transient failures (HTTP 5xx, timeouts, connection resets) up to 3 times with exponential backoff and jitter, fails immediately on 4xx and auth errors, and logs each retry with the command name and status. Build on the 5xx retry added in job 86p4 rather than duplicating it. Add a check, as a lint rule or test, that fails when code calls gh or an HTTP client outside the wrapper. Add tests that inject a transient 500 into 'athena land --pr' and the other GitHub-calling commands. Each test should assert that a one-off 500 is retried and succeeds, and that persistent 500s fail after the limit with a clear error.
